title: Taiwanese American Professionals Boston
content_html: Taiwanese American Professionals Boston (TAP-BOS) is a chapter of the Taiwanese American Citizens League (TACL), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit run entirely by volunteers. TAP-BOS serves the Taiwanese American community in the greater Boston area by providing a supportive environment where members can reflect, grow, and build meaningful relationships. The chapter runs programming centered on leadership development and cultural engagement, including the EDGE Program.
